_readme: One row per retailer marketplace. scripts/generate-retailer-adapters.mjs turns each row into
packages/frontend/public/logos/connectors/<slug>.svg, from the tools of the adapter named in `source`.
Edit a row here and run the generator; never edit the generated files by hand (CI runs --check).
hosts: one entry fixes the base URL; several entries become a choice at install (envVarMeta.options).
keyPath: menu path to the API key in the seller back office, parts separated by ' > '.
sellerHelpUrl: the retailer's own seller help or application page; null uses the back office sign-in page.
sources: where the host and the access rule come from (not shown to users).

retailers.name: Decathlon Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: These are the sales channels of the euro shop.
retailers.shopIdNote: Decathlon keeps one shop per currency group, so a user who sells in several currencies has several shops.
retailers.access: Decathlon approves each seller through an application form, a contract and a brand list (a curated marketplace).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: Only the European (EUR) seller platform is known to this connector. Decathlon runs separate shops in local currency for Switzerland, Romania, Hungary, the United Kingdom and Asia-Pacific on other addresses, which this connector does not reach.

retailers.name: Carrefour Marketplace
retailers.access: Carrefour selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`devenir_vendeur@carrefour.com` for France, `es_marketplace_carrefourinfo@carrefour.com` for Spain).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: MediaMarkt Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: In Italy the marketplace trades as MediaWorld. All countries share one seller platform.
retailers.shopIdNote: MediaMarkt usually opens one shop per country, so most sellers have several shops under one user.
retailers.access: MediaMarkt takes applications through a form per country, followed by a business verification (KYC).
retailers.keyPath: your login name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Leroy Merlin Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Bricoman France sells from the same shop.
retailers.shopIdNote: Users with several shops are common on Leroy Merlin.
retailers.access: Leroy Merlin takes applications through a form, followed by a business verification (KYC).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: Leroy Merlin Poland (a separate shop in PLN) and Romania run on other addresses, which this connector does not reach.

retailers.name: B&Q Marketplace
retailers.shopIdNote: Sellers on B&Q are known to set the shop id, also with a single shop.
retailers.access: B&Q takes applications through the Kingfisher Merchant Hub; the business must be VAT-registered.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: B&Q belongs to Kingfisher, which is why the seller platform is on a Kingfisher address.

retailers.name: Conforama Marketplace
retailers.access: Conforama selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`marketplacebyconfo@conforama.fr`).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Debenhams Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Orders can also come from Ireland, Australia and the United States.
retailers.access: Debenhams selects its sellers through an application form and asks for a UK legal entity and a UK bank account.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Douglas Partner Program
retailers.nameInSentence: the Douglas Partner Program, the Douglas marketplace,
retailers.access: Douglas selects its partners through its partner contact form.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: EmpikPlace
retailers.access: Empik takes applications through a form and reviews them in about one working day; it is open to businesses established in the EU.
retailers.keyPath: the user menu (top right) > Klucz API
notes: The connector calls `https://marketplace.empik.com`, the address Empik's developer portal names for the API. If you sign in at `marketplace.czs.empik.com`, that is the same account, but that address does not answer API calls.

retailers.name: ePRICE Marketplace
retailers.access: ePRICE approves each seller after a sign-up on its site.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: home24 Marketplace
retailers.shopIdNote: home24 opens one shop per country, so a seller in several countries has several shops under one user.
retailers.access: home24 selects its sellers: after a first contact it sends an invitation link to open the shop.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: La Redoute Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Belgium and Luxembourg are announced for January 2027.
retailers.access: La Redoute is selective and reviews each application made on its seller page.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Maisons du Monde Marketplace
retailers.access: Maisons du Monde selects its sellers among businesses established in the EU; contact it by e-mail (`marketplace@maisonsdumonde.com`).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Worten Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Worten left the Spanish market on 1 August 2026, so the marketplace sells in Portugal only.
retailers.access: Worten takes applications through a form on its seller page.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Best Buy Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: The United States marketplace opened in August 2025.
retailers.access: Best Buy takes applications in each country; its seller hub explains the onboarding for the United States.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API Keys

retailers.name: BUT Marketplace
retailers.access: BUT selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`BUT_MARKETPLACE_BIZDEV@but.fr`).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Conrad Marketplace

retailers.access: Conrad vets each seller after a contact form; the business must be VAT-registered and ship from a warehouse in Germany.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: El Corte Inglés Marketplace
retailers.access: El Corte Inglés selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`infovendedormarketplace@elcorteingles.es`).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Mountain Warehouse Marketplace
retailers.access: Mountain Warehouse takes applications on its seller page or by e-mail (`sellwithus@mountainwarehouse.com`) and asks for a UK company with a UK VAT number.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: PcComponentes Marketplace
retailers.access: PcComponentes takes applications on its marketplace page.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Vente-unique Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Further European countries are served from the same shop.
retailers.shopIdNote: Users with several shops are common on Vente-unique.
retailers.access: Vente-unique takes applications on its seller page.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Boulanger Marketplace
retailers.access: Boulanger selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`marketplace.interne@boulanger.com`). The business must be based in the EU, ship from the EU and offer customer service in French.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Leen Bakker Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Belgium is sold in Dutch and in French from the same shop.
retailers.access: Leen Bakker selects its sellers (a curated marketplace); apply through its new sales partner page or by e-mail.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Macy's Marketplace
retailers.access: Macy's takes applications through its marketplace site; sellers need a US tax id, a hand-signed W-9, a US warehouse, a UPS account for returns and GS1-registered UPC codes.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Nature & Découvertes Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: The shop is French; orders also come from Belgium, Luxembourg, Germany and Switzerland.
retailers.access: Nature & Découvertes selects its sellers through the application form on its marketplace page; the business must be registered in the French trade register (RCS) and follow French VAT rules.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Nordstrom Marketplace
retailers.access: Nordstrom selects its sellers after a first call; sellers need a US business registration, an EIN, Tax ID or LEI, a W-9, a US bank account and US shipping and return addresses.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Obelink Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: All countries share one seller platform.
retailers.access: Obelink takes applications through its partner programme form or by direct contact.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Auchan Marketplace
retailers.access: Auchan selects its sellers; contact its marketplace team by e-mail (`fr-liste_ecom_marketplace@auchan.fr`). The business must be based in Europe.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: Bricomarché Marketplace
retailers.access: Bricomarché selects its sellers; contact its marketplace team by e-mail (`SASEM_MARKETPLACE_BM@mousquetaires.com`). Customer service must be in French.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The same seller account can also sell on Brico Cash and Bricorama once the Bricomarché account manager switches those sites on.

The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: Cultura Marketplace
retailers.access: Cultura reviews applications sent through the form on its website; the company and its warehouse must be in the EU and every product needs an EAN.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: INNO Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Products are listed in Dutch and in French on the same shop.
retailers.access: INNO screens every seller (a curated marketplace): a business check through Stripe, then an invitation link to open the shop, valid for 48 hours.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: Rue du Commerce Marketplace
retailers.access: Rue du Commerce selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`service.marchands@rueducommerce.com`) or through its seller form.
retailers.keyPath: your e-mail address (top right) > My account > API key

retailers.name: Sarenza Marketplace
retailers.access: Sarenza selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`marketplace@sarenza.com`). It asks for experience on other marketplaces and official distributor status in France for the brands you sell.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: Shop Apotheke Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: The marketplace is live in Germany and Austria; Italy (redcare.it) and Belgium (farmaline.be) run a partner programme on their own contracts.
retailers.shopIdNote: Shop Apotheke signs a separate contract for each country, so a seller in several countries has several shops.
retailers.access: Shop Apotheke approves each partner, may review the product feed first, and signs a contract per country; apply on its partner page.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: Only the Germany and Austria shops are confirmed on this address; Italian and Belgian shops are assumed to use it too.

retailers.name: Sprinter Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Spain and Portugal are two sales channels of the same shop, each with its own prices.
retailers.access: Sprinter takes applications through the form on its seller page; fees and commission are agreed with Sprinter.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Superdrug Marketplace
retailers.access: Superdrug selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`marketplace@uk.aswatson.com`).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Tesco Marketplace
retailers.access: Tesco takes applications through its seller application form and vets each seller; the business must be registered and VAT-registered in the UK.
retailers.keyPath: your initials (top right) > Personal Settings > API Key
notes: The API key belongs to the user who created it: it stops working if that user is disabled or loses the Owner or Manager role.

retailers.name: HORNBACH Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Germany and the Czech Republic are two sales channels of the same shop.
retailers.access: HORNBACH vets each partner through its application form; partners ship from the EU, give support in the local language and have a German VAT number or use the OSS scheme.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: XXXLutz Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Germany is the main market; ChannelEngine lists the other countries.
retailers.access: XXXLutz takes applications through its registration form; it requires a German VAT number or the OSS scheme, a warehouse in the EU and an EAN for every product.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: MODIVO Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Each market has its own seller account.
retailers.shopIdNote: MODIVO opens a separate account for each market, so a seller in several countries has several shops.
retailers.access: MODIVO is a closed marketplace: contact MODIVO, which checks your business against its requirements (delivery and return terms, carriers, 48-hour shipping, EAN codes).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: The Range Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Sellers can also choose to deliver to the Republic of Ireland, the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man.
retailers.access: The Range takes applications on its marketplace sign-up page and verifies each seller: it asks for a UK company registration number that matches Companies House and for the UK VAT details of the business.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The Range moved its marketplace to a new seller back office in 2026 and migrated the existing seller accounts. The user name and password of the earlier Partner Central API do not work here; the connector needs the API key from the new back office.

retailers.name: Roman Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Products from marketplace sellers are delivered only to UK addresses, including Northern Ireland, the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man.
retailers.access: Roman selects its sellers through an enquiry form on its seller page, which asks, among other things, whether the business ships its orders from the UK.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Atlas For Men Marketplace
retailers.access: Atlas For Men selects its sellers; contact its marketplace team by e-mail (`vendeur.marketplace@atlasformen.com`) to find out whether your products are eligible.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Brico Dépôt Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: This is the marketplace of the Spanish and Portuguese Brico Dépôt sites; the French Brico Dépôt site does not take marketplace sellers.
retailers.shopIdNote: Spain and Portugal are two separate shops of the same seller account
retailers.access: Brico Dépôt takes applications through the form on its seller portal (Merchants Hub). The business needs a legal address in the EU and must handle invoicing, delivery, returns and customer service for consumers itself.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Praxis & Brico Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Praxis sells in the Netherlands and Brico in Belgium; product texts are needed in Dutch and in French.
retailers.shopIdNote: Praxis (Netherlands) and Brico (Belgium) are two shops of the same seller account: the NL shop sells on Praxis, the BE shop on Brico
retailers.access: Praxis and Brico take applications through the join-our-marketplace form linked from their seller help centre. Sellers need a chamber of commerce registration, products in DIY, garden or home categories made under BSCI standards, and product texts in Dutch and French.
retailers.keyPath: the profile icon (top right) > Personal settings > API key
notes: Only users with the Store Administration role see the API key tab.

retailers.name: Private Sport Shop Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Orders come from all EU countries and Switzerland; a seller must at least ship to France.
retailers.access: Private Sport Shop takes sellers on request: write to its onboarding team (`marketplace@privatesportshop.com`). Sellers must at least ship to France and send orders directly to customers.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Jardiland & Gamm vert Marketplace
retailers.nameInSentence: the Jardiland and Gamm vert marketplace
retailers.access: Teract, the group behind Jardiland and Gamm vert, selects its sellers; contact its marketplace team by e-mail (`marketplace@teract.com`). The business must have its headquarters in the EU, with an intra-community VAT number.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: One shop sells on both jardiland.com and gammvert.fr.

retailers.name: Ubaldi Marketplace
retailers.access: Ubaldi selects its sellers; contact its marketplace team by e-mail (`marketplace@ubaldi.com`) to find out whether your products are eligible.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: vtwonen Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: The shop is in Dutch; sellers must deliver free of charge to the Netherlands and Flanders.
retailers.access: vtwonen chooses its suppliers and products through an internal committee; apply by e-mail (`shop@vtwonen.nl`). Sellers ship from their own stock, offer free delivery and free returns, and answer customer questions within 24 hours.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Greenweez Marketplace
retailers.access: Greenweez accepts sellers of organic and eco-responsible products that meet its specifications; apply through its seller page or by e-mail (`devenir_vendeur@greenweez.com`). An EU VAT number is required.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Bunnings Marketplace
retailers.access: Bunnings selects its sellers: register your interest through its seller interest form. Sellers must reply to customers within one business day, dispatch orders within two business days and keep cancellations below 2% and disputes below 3%.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Coppel Marketplace
retailers.access: Coppel reviews each seller: registration starts with an application, followed by a check of the business documents. Sellers need a Mexican tax id (RFC), electronic invoicing and stock in Mexico.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Kohl's Marketplace
retailers.access: Kohl's takes applications through its marketplace application form; the business must be registered in the US, provide a W-9 and a certificate of liability insurance, and have a US address for returns.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Ripley Marketplace
retailers.access: Ripley reviews seller applications; it charges a commission per category and no listing fee.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: Only the Chilean seller platform is known to this connector. Ripley Peru runs a separate seller platform on another address, which this connector does not reach.

retailers.name: Stadium Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Offers can appear on both Stadium and Stadium Outlet.
retailers.shopIdNote: Stadium opens one shop per country under the same user; the API key is the same, the shop id picks Sweden or Finland.
retailers.access: Stadium selects its sellers: contact the Stadium Connect team by e-mail (`stadium.connect@stadium.com`); approved sellers receive a registration link. Office and warehouse must be in the EU.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: E.Leclerc Marketplace
retailers.access: E.Leclerc selects its sellers; contact its marketplace team by e-mail (`account.marketplace@e-leclerc.com`). The business must be based in the eurozone, hold a European bank account and ship only from the eurozone.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: Kiabi Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: One shop sells in all countries; each new country needs the approval of the Kiabi account manager, and Belgium needs titles and descriptions in French and Dutch.
retailers.access: Kiabi selects its sellers through the form on its Devenez marchand page; the business needs a legal entity in Europe, French-speaking customer service, valid EANs and its own stock (no drop-shipping).
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: La Poste Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: Offers appear on both laposte.fr shops, for consumers and for professionals.
retailers.access: La Poste selects its sellers through its marketplace page or by e-mail (`partenariat.marketplace@laposte.fr`); the business must be registered in the French trade register (RCS), keep its stock in the EU and ship with La Poste group services.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: LDLC Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: The shop is French; orders also come from Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Spain and Italy.
retailers.access: LDLC selects a small number of sellers per category through the form on its reseller page; head office and warehouse must be in the EU, the seller must own its stock (no dropshipping), use its own logistics and offer customer service in French.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
notes: LDLC group's Materiel.net and Slood sites take offers through the same seller platform.

The seller address of this connector is the one the platform assigns to this retailer; no seller guide names it yet. If your seller back office opens at a different address, tell us in the chat so we can correct it.

retailers.name: Pixmania Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: One shop sells in France, Spain and Italy; Spain and Italy are separate sales channels of the same shop, each with its own prices.
retailers.access: Pixmania selects its sellers; write to its partnerships team (`partenariats@pixmania.com`). Once accepted, the business completes its identity checks with the payment provider in the seller back office before it can sell. Pixmania charges a monthly fee and a commission per sale.
retailers.keyPath: your e-mail address (top of the page) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Printemps Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: France is the main channel; Belgium is a second sales channel of the same shop that Printemps switches on.
retailers.access: Printemps hand-picks partner brands for fashion, beauty and home and signs a contract with each; there is no public application form. Partners ship from a warehouse in the EU within 72 hours, handle returns themselves and serve customers in French and English. Printemps charges a monthly subscription and a commission per sale.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Place des Tendances Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: The shop is French; Place des Tendances also delivers to customers in other European countries.
retailers.access: Place des Tendances selects its sellers; send a letter of interest with your brand's details to `marketplace@placedestendances.com`. Sellers pay a monthly subscription and a commission per sale and must meet response-time and shipping-time targets.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Super-Pharm Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: This is the marketplace of shop.super-pharm.co.il in Israel; the Polish Super-Pharm site does not take marketplace sellers.
retailers.access: Super-Pharm approves each seller before it can list; sellers keep their own stock and deliver to customers in Israel themselves, and Super-Pharm takes a commission on each sale.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: Lowe's Marketplace
retailers.access: Lowe's selects its sellers through the application on its marketplace page; the business must be registered in the US with a US address, a W-9 and an EIN, ship from the US with UPS, USPS or FedEx (parcels within 24 business hours, freight within three business days) and print GS1-certified UPC codes on its products.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: IBS.it Marketplace
retailers.access: IBS.it accepts professional sellers and confirms each seller's eligibility before the first listing; the catalogue covers books, music, film, games, stationery and gifts.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.name: H&M Home Marketplace
retailers.countriesNote: One shop sells to all nine countries, with a price per country.
retailers.access: H&M Home chooses the brands it sells next to its own range and reviews each application; it charges no setup, monthly or commission fee, the margin is agreed per brand, with invoices every two weeks and 30-day payment terms.
retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

retailers.keyPath: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key
